title: IEBIMAGE building a forms control buffer module: FCB then NAME statements, SYSUT1 the image library DISP=OLD
shapes: BDLD jcl/BDLDUT4.jcl IMG030: EXEC PGM=IEBIMAGE, SYSUT1 DD DSN=SYS1.IMAGELIB,DISP=OLD, SYSIN holds FCB CH1=1,CH12=80,LPI=8 and NAME BDLD
asserts: Each control statement in the inline SYSIN stream is one jcl_utility_cards fact with utility IEBIMAGE, dd SYSIN, verb FCB or NAME and its operands as written; SYSUT1 is a jcl_dds fact on SYS1.IMAGELIB with disp OLD. IEBIMAGE is system supplied: no program edge into the estate. The NAME operand BDLD names a library module, not a program or a data set.

citations.quote: Forms control buffer modules for the 3800 and 4248 that specify controls for the vertical line spacing and any one of 12 channel codes per line.
Creates a 3800 or 4248 forms control buffer module and stores it in an image library.
The NAME statement is required, and must be the last statement in each operation group.
DISP=OLD should be specified on the SYSUT1 DD statement.
